description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerDao class, a data access object responsible for handling database operations related to PerformanceTracker entities within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting performance tracker records, as well as managing associated reviewers and related filtering queries.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing CRUD and complex queries on PerformanceTracker entities, including managing reviewers and supporting various search filters within the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTracker entity by its ID if it exists and is active.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing PerformanceTracker IDs from a provided list, filtering out deleted records.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackList
methods.description: Fetches a list of PerformanceTracker entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PerformanceTrackers matching specified search filters.

methods.name: savePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Persists a new PerformanceTracker and its reviewers within a transaction.

methods.name: updatePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Updates an existing PerformanceTracker and its reviewers, handling additions and deletions of reviewers.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on PerformanceTrackers by updating their status to 'deleted'.

methods.name: getReviewerListByTrackerId
methods.description: Fetches a list of reviewer associations for a specified PerformanceTracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IDs for all PerformanceTracker records.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Gets IDs of PerformanceTrackers associated with a specific reviewer.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Gets IDs of PerformanceTrackers associated with a specific employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers of employees who are reviewers, filtered by reviewer ID.

methods.name: isTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Checks whether a given employee number is assigned as a reviewer for any active PerformanceTracker.

methods.name: isTrackerOwnerEditable
methods.description: Determines if a PerformanceTracker is editable based on whether it has associated activity logs.
